title: Loi ordinaire L/2019/0034/AN du 4 juillet 2019 portant Code de l'environnement de la République de Guinée
citation: Loi L/2019/0034/AN du 04 juillet 2019 portant Code de l'environnement, promulguée par le Décret D/2019/221/PRG/SGG
evidence: Article 212 of the Code (MEDD scan opened 2026-11-03): "Le présent Code, qui entre en vigueur à compter de la date de sa promulgation, sera enregistré, publié au Journal Officiel de la République et exécuté comme Loi de l'État." Page 1 of the scan is the promulgation decree D/2019/221/PRG/SGG ("Article 1er : Est promulguée la Loi L/2019/0034/AN du 04 juillet 2019, portant Code de l'Environnement de la République de Guinée. Article 2 : Le présent Décret qui prend effet à compter de sa date de signature"), whose date stamp reads "26 JUIL 2019" (read from the image). The Assembly signed the Code on 04 juillet 2019.
notes: Environmental framework act, family F2 (the register row carried F4 and is now F2). Article 211 repeals Ordonnance N° 045/PRG/87 du 28 mai 1987 portant Code de l'environnement. Stored from the MEDD scan (HTTP 200, 16843143 bytes, no text layer). The text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tesseract-ocr-fra 1:4.1.0-2, pdftoppm at 200 dpi, all 45 pages, page 1 the promulgation decree then the Code, pages in order), stored as read with no correction. The gazette text was not found: the SGG instrument index lists the Code as published in JO 2019-12-27-sp, but the PDF served at that address (8 pages) does not contain it, and the JO 2019-07 ordinary issue is a scan. The in_force date is the promulgation date, not the 04 juillet 2019 adoption date the register carried. Implemented by gn-arrete-2022-1646-evaluations-environnementales and gn-arrete-2023-1595-evaluations-environnementales. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.

title: Arrêté A/2022/1646/MEDD/CAB/SGG du 25 juillet 2022 portant procédure administrative d'évaluations environnementales
citation: Arrêté A/2022/1646/MEDD/CAB/SGG du 25 juillet 2022 (Journal officiel 2022-07), pris sur la base du Code de l'environnement
evidence: Article 71 as printed in JO 2022-07 (opened 2026-11-03): "Sont abrogées toutes dispositions antérieures contraires à compter de sa date de signature, sera enregistré et publié au Journal Officiel de la République." followed by "Conakry, le 25 Juillet 2022". The sentence is garbled in the gazette (it merges the repeal clause with the commencement clause); the signature date is the in-force date.
notes: Implementing order of the Code de l'environnement for environmental and social impact assessment (procedure before the AGEE). Record text is the order's own pages of JO 2022-07 (from the heading to the signature), read column by column; a typographical error in the source ('Article18') is stored as printed. Replaced 2023-05-05 by gn-arrete-2023-1595-evaluations-environnementales: the SGG instrument index lists A/2022/1646 as 'Abrogé par' A/2023/1595, so the second record is a repeal record dated 2023-05-05. The companion Arrêté A/2022/1647/MEDD/CAB/SGG (conditions for approval to carry out an environmental assessment, same issue) is not in scope. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.

title: Arrêté A/2023/1595/MEDD/CAB/SGG du 5 mai 2023 modifiant l'arrêté A/2022/1646/MEDD/CAB/SGG du 25 juillet 2022, portant procédure administrative d'évaluations environnementales
evidence: Article 72 as printed in JO 2023-05 (opened 2026-11-03): "Sont abrogées toutes dispositions antérieures contraires à compter de sa date de signature, sera enregistré et publié au Journal Officiel de la République." followed by "Conakry, le 05 Mai 2023". The sentence is garbled in the gazette; the signature date is the in-force date.
notes: Despite its title ('modifiant') the order is a complete restatement of the procedure (72 articles, strategic environmental assessment, impact assessment categories A to D, environmental authorisation, compliance control, sanctions). Record text is the order's own pages of JO 2023-05 (heading to signature), read column by column; the source numbers two consecutive articles 51 and has no article 52, stored as printed. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.

title: Arrêté A/2023/3256/MEDD/CAB/SGG du 12 juillet 2023 portant attributions, organisation et fonctionnement du Comité National sur les changements climatiques
evidence: Article 22 as printed in JO 2023-07 (116-page ordinary issue, opened 2026-11-03): "Le Présent Arrêté qui prend effet à compter de sa date de signature, sera enregistré et publié au Journal Officiel de la République." followed by "Conakry, le 12 juillet 2023"; the signature date is the in-force date.
notes: Institutional order for the national climate committee; the closest thing to a climate framework instrument found (no climate framework act exists on the official pages searched). The SGG index lists an earlier Arrêté A/2021/187/MEEF/CAB/SGG du 01 mars 2021 on the same committee (JO 2021-03); whether A/2023/3256 replaces it was not read. Record text is the order's own text in pages 53 to 55 of the PDF of the ordinary issue JO 2023-07 (gazette pages 765 to 767), read column by column from the heading to the signature line; this PDF has a text layer, so no OCR was used (the PDF listed earlier, guinee-jo-2023-07-sp.pdf, which the SGG index links, is a special issue of 28 scanned pages that holds only decrees and does not contain this order, so it was OCRed at 200 dpi to check and not used). The printed article 21 says 'Décret' for 'Arrêté' and the preamble misspells 'Enviroonement'; both are stored as printed. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.

title: Loi ordinaire L/2024/002/CNT du 12 janvier 2024 portant réglementation de la publicité en République de Guinée
citation: Loi L/2024/002/CNT du 12 janvier 2024, promulguée par le Décret D/2024/067/PRG/CNRD/SGG du 17 avril 2024 (Journal officiel 2024-04)
evidence: Article 92: "La présente Loi, qui entre en vigueur à compter de sa date de promulgation, sera enregistrée et publiée au Journal Officiel de la République." The promulgation decree printed in the same issue reads "Article 1er: Est promulguée la Loi L/2024/002/CNT du 12 Janvier 2024, portant Règlementation de la Publicité en République de Guinée." and ends "Conakry, le 17 Avril 2024" (JO 2024-04, opened 2026-11-03).
notes: Umbrella for misleading claims in advertising, the closest Guinean rule to an environmental-claims rule: Article 62 makes false or misleading advertising claims about the nature, composition, qualities, properties or results of goods or services a delict, and Article 83 gives civil damages for it. The law does not name environmental or climate claims; Article 25 (content of the advertising message) only says it must not encourage behaviour harmful to health, the safety of persons and property or the environment. Article 91 gives existing professionals six months from the setting up of the regulatory body (Article 7) to comply; no commencement date for that body was read. Record text is the law's own pages of JO 2024-04 (pages 4 to 15, left and right columns read separately, the promulgation decree and the neighbouring laws on the same pages left out), line breaks and word-end hyphens as printed. The ordinary issue is the electronic copy; the site says only the paper edition is authoritative. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.

title: Loi L/94/003/CTRN du 14 février 1994 relative à la protection des consommateurs, au contrôle des denrées, marchandises et services et à la répression des fraudes commerciales
evidence: Article 20 of the scan (5 pages, opened 2026-11-03; the copy has holes where the page was damaged): "La présente loi qui ent[r]e en vigueur au jour de sa promulgation, sera enregistrée et publ[i]ée au Journal Officiel de la République et exécutée comme loi de l'Etat." signed "Conakry le 14 FEVRIER 1994" by the President of the Republic (Lansana Conté). Read from the image.
notes: Consumer protection act (chapter I: economic freedoms, consumer rights and duties of economic operators; Article 4 duties of operators who put a product or service on the market). Article 3 (last paragraph, partly damaged) says products and services must meet a general duty of fairness so as not to mislead the consumer or distort competition. It does not name environmental claims. The SGG index search result for it shows no 'Abrogé par' line, and the index lists Décret D/94/015 of 14 février 1994 (Conseil national de la consommation) as its implementing decree (the decree cites it as L/93/003/CTRN) and Loi L/94/040/CTRN du 28 décembre 1994 on competition and price freedom (not in scope). Stored from the scan (5 pages, no text layer, parts of the page damaged so the OCR has gaps and misreads). The text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tesseract-ocr-fra 1:4.1.0-2, pdftoppm at 200 dpi, all 5 pages, in order), stored as read with no correction. The brief's 'Loi L/2016/?' consumer law was not found; the SGG index searches for 'consommateurs' and 'concurrence' returned no later consumer law. No English translation: looked for at https://www.sgg.gov.gn, https://journal-officiel.sgg.gov.gn, https://medd.gov.gn and https://www.bcrg-guinee.org on 2026-11-03; French is the only language any of them serves.
